rv.q: Audiences at recent Globe productions have enjoyed or had to endure several egocentric productions which have been more about the director's agenda rather than the playwright's so it's great to have the refreshingly steady hand of veteran director Nancy Meckler in the driving seat for Shakespeare's masterpiece, King Lear.

Kenneth Branagh both directs and stars as King Lear, Shakespeare’s foolishly narcissistic father who allows flattery (and then the lack of it), to cloud his judgement of familial love when deciding how to divide his kingdom between three daughters of differing worthiness. Kenneth Branagh in KING LEAR.
